subject: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <sam@ellx.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane

Hi Samir —

Good to meet last week. Per our call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a small sample of the testcases/promptpack we propose to provision into your sandbox. High-level ask: confirm the provisioning windows and the constraints below so we can lock the close timeline.

Deliverables (Redwood -> Ellx):
- Ephemeral eval-kit (eval-kit-v1.zip) delivered to S3 staging lane
- Prompt pack + 250 testcases (sample-testcases.csv) for acceptance testing
- MAP draft that covers timeline, acceptance criteria, and usage constraints (attached)

Key constraints we need you to confirm:
1) Non-public use: assets provided are for evaluation only — no public redistribution or model release.
2) Retention: sandbox copies must be deleted within 90 days of acceptance unless we agree to an extension.
3) Access: ephemeral credentials only; no cross-account transfer.

Proposed MAP milestones:
- 04/06: Ellx confirms constraints and procurement ok to proceed
- 04/08: Redwood delivers staging credentials + eval kit
- 04/15: Acceptance run (5k queries)
- 04/20: MAP sign & closure + optional short pilot

Attachments: MAP-draft-ellx.docx, sample-testcases.csv, eval-kit-v1.zip (stub)

Would you confirm the above and flag any changes to the retention or usage language? If Procurement needs a separate doclet, we can produce a short MPA addendum.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Rao <sam@ellx.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: RetailCo Procurement <procure@retailco.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane

Priya —

Thanks for the note and the materials. We like the lane approach. A few quick asks from our side:

- Retention: can we limit deletion to 60 days post-acceptance instead of 90? Procurement prefers shorter windows for third-party assets.
- Sandbox: we need a dedicated ingest window (48-72 hrs) where RW files are immutable; after ingest we run internal QA. Can you provide MD5 checksums for the eval-kit?
- Usage constraints: we accept eval-only language but need an explicit clause that forbids using the pack for model training or fine-tuning (even internally).

I'll loop Procurement on the MAP and they may request their standard security attestation. If you can produce a one-page addendum noting the training prohibition and the 60-day retention, we should be able to accelerate.

—Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Machine Learning, Ellx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <sam@ellx.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane

Samir —

Appreciate the quick read. We can accommodate the adjustments; see answers inline and an updated MAP attached (MAP-draft-ellx-v2.docx).

- Retention: agreed to 60 days post-acceptance. We'll add the specific deletion window and a timestamped audit record requirement.
- Ingest window: we'll provide a 72-hour immutable staging window and include MD5 + SHA256 checksums for the eval-kit. Expect the checksums in the staging manifest we’ll push with credentials.
- Training prohibition: we'll add a hard prohibition on using assets for model training or fine-tuning in the MAP addendum. That clause will be explicit and include sample audit language (logs, alerts).

Updated milestones (attached MAP v2):
- 04/06: Ellx confirmation (this week)
- 04/08 EOD: Redwood issues ephemeral keys + manifest (checksums)
- 04/09–04/11: Ingest window (72 hrs immutability)
- 04/12–04/15: Acceptance runs (Ellx performs 5k checks)
- 04/16: Final signoff / DocuSign

Attachments: MAP-draft-ellx-v2.docx (updated)

If Procurement needs an authorization template, Marissa can share our standard 1-page addendum. Karthik — can your team prepare the staging manifest and confirm we can guarantee immutable S3 links for the 72-hour window?

Best,
Priya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Naranajan <priya_naranajan@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <sam@ellx.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 2:28 PM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Updated milestones (attached MAP v2): ...

We can do the immutable ingest. Tech notes for Ellx engineering:
- We'll publish a pre-signed S3 URL with object lock set for 72 hrs (object-lock governance mode) so files are immutable during the ingest window.
- We'll include MD5 + SHA256 checksums in the staging manifest and S3 ETag for extra assurance.
- Prompt pack ingestion: please confirm max sequence length we should validate against (defaulting to 2k tokens) — if you have longer prompts we'll need to adjust our ingestion pipeline and can provide a quantized variant to reduce size.

Marissa — can you drop the 1-page procurement addendum in the shared Drive link so I can reference it in the manifest? Once Ellx confirms prompt sizes I'll schedule the staging job for 04/08 morning PST.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <sam@ellx.ai>, Priya Naranajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning protocol and MAP: evaluation asset lane

Samir / team —

Thanks — this looks actionable. Quick commitments from Redwood:
- We will deliver the staging manifest + checksums and immutable links on 2027-04-08 by 10:00 PST.
- We accept the 60-day deletion window and the training prohibition; language is in MAP v2.
- Next steps for close: Marissa to upload the procurement addendum to the Drive link; Priya to share DocuSign envelope; Ellx signs by 04/14 to keep the 04/20 pilot cadence.

Mutual action plan (short):
1) Ellx confirm prompt max length & Procurement signoff — due 04/06
2) Redwood deliver staging manifest + links — due 04/08 10:00 PST (Ben)
3) Ellx ingest + acceptance runs — 04/09–04/15 (Samir)
4) Final sign & DocuSign close — target 04/16 (all)

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/envelope/envelope-0a12b34
Drive MAP v2: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/1aBcD-MAP-draft-ellx
HubSpot reference: HS-934572

If that timeline works for Ellx, I'll mark the deal stage and prepare a one-time staging credit for the pilot.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
